text:
divya: starting a quick baseline pass for harbor-3b on dev. goal: sanity prompts + check int8 quant vs fp16 for hallucination/regression. pinging @devon @alex

devon: on it. will run 5 canonical prompts and paste outputs.

alex: can you add the simple eval script? i can run locally against the dev endpoint.

divya: quick prompts:
```
1) identity: "What is your name?"
2) math: "What is 37 * 21?"
3) factual: "Who wrote 'Pride and Prejudice'?"
4) instruction: "Summarize the benefits of caching in two sentences."
5) code: "Write a short Python fn to reverse a list."
```
curl snippet to call dev endpoint:
```
curl -s -X POST https://dev-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_KEY" \n  -d '{"model":"harbor-3b","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":200}'
```

devon: results (quick): fp16 -> identity OK; math correct; factual Q3 answered 'Jane Austen' correct; instruction concise; code ok. int8 -> identity OK; math correct; factual Q3: gave extra false book fact (small hallucination); code truncated table output once.

meenal: quick note — sampling config matters. run greedy + top-p=0.9 to compare variability.

alex: ran eval script, logged simple metrics: fp16 ppl 12.3, int8 ppl 12.8. fp16 exact-match on code tests 5/5, int8 4/5. gist of outputs: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abc123

ci-bot: deploy(dev,harbor-3b-int8) succeeded @2332100005

divya: next-steps checklist:
- run 50-case QA suite (assign @devon)
- run KVCACHE stress + streaming (assign @alex)
- perf: p50/p95/p99 latency + token cost (alex)
- create regression eval and store snapshots (meenal)
- reproduce hallucination cases with fixed seed

devon: assigned, will post QA results by EOD.

meenal: note: int8 shows slight degradation past 1024 tokens for instruction-following. add prompt-rewrite test.

alex: also adding streaming token trace + cost per-token to checklist.

divya: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
